Game Overview

Trash Dash is a action title where race through lively, obstacle-filled environments as a feisty feline in Trash Dash. Gather scraps to unlock power-ups, while swift reflexes and strategic paths ensure victory. With diverse characters and vibrant maps, each adrenaline-pumping adventure promises fresh fun and dynamic gameplay. Can you outpace the challenges?
